name: foreman
description: A tight senior-engineer toolkit for Claude Code.

plugins.name: foreman
plugins.description: TDD, code review, security and performance audits, and documentation that doesn't read like AI wrote it, plus four hooks: one refuses to write a credential into a file, one refuses a commit that is two changes or a subject nobody can read, one speaks up when a diff outgrows its task, when production code lands without a test, or when a comment narrates the code instead of explaining it, and one asks before you finish if the suite never ran.
